name: auth
query: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.rol FROM users u JOIN passwords p ON u.id = p.iduser WHERE u."user" = $1 AND p.password = crypt($2, p.password);

name: register
query: WITH new_user AS (INSERT INTO users ("user", rol, name, lastname, email, created) VALUES ($1, 2, $2, $3, $4, NOW()) RETURNING id) INSERT INTO passwords (iduser, password) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM new_user), crypt($5, gen_salt('bf'))) RETURNING (SELECT id FROM new_user);
